interpretation: 'Whoever receives anyone I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me.' With 13.16 (an envoy, apostolos, is not greater than the one who sent him) read as stating a representation principle for envoys: what is done to the one sent counts as done to the sender, and this transfers along the chain from the Father to Jesus to those Jesus sends. Textual report only. The verse concerns reception of an envoy, not the envoy's own acts, and not founding.
